description:
Returns the rate cards the custodial lending desks post (bitcoin collateral), one row per product: the representative APR and its range, term, maximum LTV, custody and liquidation model, and the card's effective date and source. Administered rates, not market-cleared; a card older than the stated staleness is marked. Pass desk to read one desk's cards. Returns the route's payload as served.

Standard questions this tool answers (get_guide with question): SQ-V6.

desk.description: A desk id as the payload names it, e.g. 'ledn', 'xapo'

name: get_desk_rates
title: Posted rates of the custodial desks
